name: Dimensional Image: Lotan: Cetarchon
descriptionTemplate: At turn start, gain [Arg1] Aliemus. After releasing {Mundus Severance}, perform {Pursuit}: {Netherblade} at the start of next turn: Deal DMG equal to 400% Lotan: Cetarchon's ATK to all enemies. This {Pursuit} benefits from the DMG Bonus that {Mundus Severance} enjoys through {Great Blade: Whalefall} and counts as a "Strike".
